search.label: Search locations
search.emptyDescription: Check the spelling, try a unit code, or browse all places A–Z.

map.label: Map
map.canvas: Floor map. Arrow keys move the map, + and − zoom in or out.

sheet.hint: Press the up or down arrow to resize the panel

home.title: Open a venue map
home.description: Scan a starting-point QR code in the building, or open the venue link from the building management.

venue.unavailableDescription: This venue has not published its map yet. Ask the nearest staff member for directions.
venue.loadFailedTitle: The map could not be loaded
venue.loadFailedDescription: Check your internet connection, then try again.
venue.serviceInactiveDescription: This venue’s digital map is currently unavailable. Ask the nearest staff member for directions.

infoPoint.notFoundDescription: This screen is not registered in the published map. Contact the building management.
infoPoint.continueDescription: Scan this QR code to take the same route on your phone.

info.description: This map is updated whenever the building manager publishes a new version.

explore.hint: Search for a place name or unit code, pick a category, or open the A–Z list.
explore.directoryEmpty: No places match these filters. Change or clear a filter.

location.missingDescription: Go back and search again by name or unit code.

origin.chooseHint: Search for the place you are at, open it, then choose “I'm here”. Or tap your position on the map.
origin.tapHint: Tap your position on the map.

route.title: Route
route.failNoPath: There is no route from your starting point to this destination.
route.failAccessible: There is no accessible route to this destination. Turn off “Accessible route” to see other routes.
route.failClosed: The route to this destination is temporarily closed.
route.failOrigin: Your starting point is not connected to a path. Change the starting point.
route.failDestination: This destination is not connected to a path yet.
route.detour: The route takes a detour because of a temporary closure:
route.graphFailed: Route paths could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not exist. Scan the QR code in the building again or open the link from the building management.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: The page could not be shown. Reload to try again.
